tv.drama.deadline.betreff: Deadline day: the clock is ticking
tv.drama.deadline.text: The transfer window closes today. Every other side wants to answer before it shuts, after which any open deal is dead. Keep an eye on your negotiations.
tv.drama.verzoegert.text: %2 hasn't come back about %1 and asks for more time. No answer is to be expected before %3.
tv.drama.hijack.text: Right in the middle of our talks, %2 has put in an offer for %1. The seller sets a deadline of %3: whoever hasn't closed by then goes away empty-handed.
tv.drama.hijack_abschluss.betreff: %2 tries to snatch %1 from us just before the signature
tv.drama.hijack_abschluss.text: Just before the signature, %2 has submitted a higher offer for %1. Outbid it or let the player go, a decision is needed by %3.
tv.drama.nachforderung.text: %2 wants more money at the last moment or the signing of %1 collapses. Pay, haggle or refuse, an answer is due by %3.
tv.drama.platzt.verein_abbruch.text: Without warning, %2 has ended the negotiations over %1 and offers no further explanation.
tv.drama.platzt.medizin.text: The doctor advises against signing %1. The move is off.
tv.drama.platzt.letzter_moment.betreff: Deal for %1 collapses at the last moment
tv.drama.platzt.letzter_moment.text: Just before the signature everything fell apart: the sides no longer meet, and the move of %1 will not happen.
tv.drama.platzt.berater_springt_ab.text: The agent refused any middle ground and ended the talks. The move of %1 is off the table.
tv.drama.platzt.rivale.text: You didn't keep bidding, so %1 goes elsewhere. The move to us has failed.
tv.drama.platzt.abgebrochen.text: After the doctor's findings, you called off the move of %1.
tv.drama.platzt.abgelehnt.text: You refused the extra demand, and the move of %1 has collapsed.
tv.drama.medizin.bestanden.text: The doctor gives the green light for %1. Medically, nothing stands in the way of the deal.
tv.drama.medizin.auffaellig.text: The doctor has found something worrying with %1. You can renegotiate the price, sign anyway or call it off. If you don't answer, we pull out.
tv.drama.medizin.durchgefallen.text: %1 has failed the medical. The doctor strongly advises against the signing.
tv.drama.antwort.nachlass_ok.text: %2 meets us on the price and the findings are priced in. The deal goes on.
tv.drama.antwort.nachlass_nein.text: %2 refuses a discount. You can still sign or call the move off.
tv.drama.antwort.gezahlt.text: %2 gets what he wanted, and the signing of %1 moves closer again.
tv.drama.antwort.ueberboten.text: With a higher offer you have left %2 behind in the race for %1.
tv.drama.streik.unruhe.blockiert.text: %1 is angry because his wish to leave is blocked, and he shows it in training. Talk to him before it sets in.
tv.drama.streik.unruhe.gebrochen.text: A broken promise gnaws at %1, and he lets the others feel it. Talk to him before it sets in.
tv.drama.streik.training.text: %1 no longer shows up for sessions. The squad is watching how you handle it.
tv.drama.streik.einsatz.text: %1 declares he no longer wants to play for the club. He is unavailable for selection until the matter is settled.
tv.drama.streik.vorstand.training.text: The board expects you to get the boycott of %1 under control before it infects the squad.
tv.drama.streik.vorstand.einsatz.betreff: The board demands a solution for %1
tv.drama.streik.vorstand.einsatz.text: A player who refuses to play damages the club's reputation. Fans and press are talking about it, and the board expects a quick solution for %1.
tv.drama.streik.ende.abgeklungen.text: %1 is back on task and the dispute has died down.
tv.drama.streik.ende.gespraech.text: After the talk, %1 returns to the squad's daily routine.
tv.drama.streik.ende.zusage.text: %1 ends the strike for as long as you keep your word. Break it and it will be worse than before.
tv.drama.streik.ende.verkauf.text: You have decided to let %1 go. He trains again until a buyer is found.
tv.drama.streik.ende.strafe.text: The punishment worked and %1 is back in training. Time will tell whether the resentment stays.
tv.drama.streik.gespraech_ok.betreff: The talk with %1 had an effect
tv.drama.streik.gespraech_ok.text: %1 gives a little. The dispute isn't over, but the mood improves.
tv.drama.streik.gespraech_nein.text: %1 listens but sticks to his stance. Try again in a few days.
tv.drama.streik.strafe_trotz.text: The punishment only egged %1 on, and the dressing room is watching closely.
tv.drama.vertrag.start.text: %2 lets it be known that %1 won't extend on the old terms and wants a yearly salary of %3. Other clubs have taken notice.
tv.drama.vertrag.frist.betreff: The deadline for %1 is running out
tv.drama.vertrag.frist.text: From now on other clubs may talk to %1 directly. If you still want to sell him for a fee, act now, or he may leave for nothing.
tv.drama.vertrag.verloren.text: The contract of %1 has run out without an agreement. He leaves the club without a fee.
tv.drama.vertrag.verlaengert.text: The contract of %1 no longer runs out and the poker game is over.
tv.drama.vertrag.aussitzen.betreff: You let the matter of %1 lie
tv.drama.vertrag.aussitzen.text: You are betting that things sort themselves out. Whether %1 stays in the end, time will tell.
tv.drama.vertrag.verlaengern.text: The demand of %1 is on the negotiating table.
tv.drama.vertrag.verkaufen.text: You are looking for a buyer for %1 while there is still a fee to be had.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.rivale: The player goes to another club.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.budget: There isn't enough money for that.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.nichts_offen: Nothing here is waiting for a decision.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.kein_streik: This player is not on strike.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.zu_frueh: He doesn't want to talk again today.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.zusage: He keeps quiet for as long as you keep your word.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.verkauf: The player is up for sale.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.kein_poker: There is no poker over this contract.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.verlaengern: The extension is on the table.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.keine_klausel: The loan agreement has no recall clause.
tv.drama.rueckmeldung.verhandlungen_voll: Too many negotiations are already running.
wartet.medizin.0: The doctor is going through the findings …
wartet.medizin.1: The examination is still under way …
wartet.medizin.2: The verdict from the clinic is due any moment …
wartet.streik.0: You are seeking a word with the player …
wartet.streik.1: The dressing room holds its breath …
wartet.streik.2: The agent confers with his player …
wartet.deadline.1: The clock to the close of the window is running …
wartet.deadline.2: Faxes pile up in the office …
md.anlass.transfer_hijack.text: %2 has stepped into the talks over %1. The market expects a bidding war.
md.anlass.transfer_geplatzt_spaet.text: Just before it was done, the move for %1 fell through. The background remains unclear.
md.anlass.spieler_streik.text: %1 is simmering: the player is shutting the club out. Observers ask how the coach intends to get a grip on the situation.
md.anlass.vertrags_poker.betreff: Will %1 let his contract run out?
md.anlass.vertrags_poker.text: The stakes are high around %1: the contract is running out and no agreement is in sight. Other clubs are already waiting.
